messages:
Alex: Hey all — quick cross-team ping for PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/24812. Small change: routing fallback order + canary config. Planning to merge Wed 15:00 PT if we get runtime/platform/infra/security sign-offs. Checklist: 1) Runtime perf/kv behavior, 2) Platform rollback/canary schedule, 3) Infra networking impact, 4) Security/logging/PII. @Tom (runtime) @Priya (platform) @Rachel (infra) @Jamie (sec) can you PTAL?

Priya: I can take platform today. One quick Q — are we shipping this behind a feature flag or a config toggle? If it's config-only we can do a progressive rollout. Can you add the canary schedule to the PR description (percent + duration)?

Tom: I'll look at runtime perf. Quick local run with staged traffic looked fine, no obvious KV-cache regressions. Left two tiny comment nits in the diff about docstrings. If those are addressed, I can approve.

Rachel: From infra/networking POV looks safe — this only reorders route priority, no new ports or infra objects. Approve from infra side. Heads-up: please update the post-deploy runbook with the fallback order note.

Jamie: Security review in progress. One concern: the new header `X-Orig-Customer` can carry customer identifiers. Please ensure we scrub that header before emitting into logs and downstream metrics. Suggest adding `logger.scrub_headers(['X-Orig-Customer'])` or equivalent. I'll give final sign-off after that change.

Alex: Thanks — pushed a tiny follow-up that strips the header in the logging path and added the canary schedule: `canary: 10% for 30m -> 50% for 1h`. Also added the runbook todo.

deploy-bot: CI | pr-24812 — 7/7 checks passed (unit, integration, lint, e2e). Merge gating: none.

Priya: :thumbsup: LGTM once Tom's docstring nits are addressed (non-blocking).

Tom: Re-reviewed the follow-up commit, nits fixed. Approving now.

Jamie: Confirming header scrub present, added a quick unit test. Approving security.

Alex: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll merge at 15:00 PT as planned unless someone objects. If anything pops after merge we can rollback to previous config and revert the change. :tada:
